summary: News Corporation filed a routine 8-K on September 28, 2026 reporting daily ASX disclosures tied to its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program for Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock. No new authorization, pricing, premium, or expiry was disclosed; exhibits 99.1/99.2 are the ASX daily buy-back notices. No advisor or board recommendation is named, and no ownership split, regulatory clock, or deal terms apply. Watch repurchase pace and remaining authorization, which signal management's valuation view and provide modest share-count support.
